review_description: Twin Solar from the 1st communication through to the final flick the switch solar operation, was fast effective and no hassle to me.The system was designed and fitted with key points of, what do you actually need based on mounting location to achieve a balance of optimum performance and value for money. They are very big on final product aesthetics, as this will be on your property for a lengthy period.
Competent and interactive quoting process. Professional, quick and tidy installation. Great customer service with all compliance, connection agreement and detailed product information supplied.

Rod Boyd has just installed a 6.6kw system in addition to our existing 7yo 1.5kw system. Was very impressed with:- effort that he went to design a layout that suited our location and needs- clear explanations of the whole thing and answered any questions I asked- stuck to the code for installing- very prompt at doing the work and alsways turned up when he said he would.He owns Twin Solar at Coal Point (suburb of Toronto on Lake Macquarie NSW)
